description: Self-hosted, local-first MCP memory server for AI agents. Fast recall at 10k memories, hybrid semantic + exact-syntax search (RAG), code & concept knowledge graphs (158 languages). All local in SQLite: no cloud, no vector DB, no API keys. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini & any MCP client.
